description: Machine-readable contract for the Sybilion standalone SPA template. Docs and pipeline audit scripts read template-coupled names from here.

editable_paths.src/AppSidebar.tsx: add nav items inside <SidebarMenu> only; may relabel Dashboard; never add a sibling pointing to /
editable_paths.src/App.tsx: add demo <Route> entries + their imports only
editable_paths.package.json: add demo-specific deps only; never bump the pinned versions
editable_paths.src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: replace body — this stub IS the primary view slot
editable_paths.src/pages/AccountPage.tsx: optional — only if the demo specifies what it shows
editable_paths.src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: optional — only if the demo specifies what it shows

uilib.comment: @sybilion/uilib is the PRIMARY UI layer: layout (AppLayout/Page*), Card, Table, Chart/ChartContainer, Select, Tabs, Dialog, Drawer, Sheet, Chip, Progress, Skeleton, Switch, Slider, Tooltip, Button, Input, Label, plus the Sybilion widgets — always reach for uilib first. The shell ships EXACTLY ONE local shadcn file: @/components/ui/alert (Alert/AlertDescription — uilib has no inline error banner). All other primitives come from uilib or a direct npm import (e.g. `import { toast } from 'sonner'`). Do NOT copy additional shadcn files into src/components/ui/.

utility_layer.rule: uilib-first: use @sybilion/uilib for layout, Card, Table, Chart, Select, Tabs, Dialog, Chip, Progress, Skeleton, Button, Input, Label and the Sybilion widgets. The only local shadcn file is alert.tsx — everything else comes from uilib or a direct npm import. recharts stays the chart engine behind uilib's ChartContainer. P-07: use `import { toast } from 'sonner'` directly for success/info notices (no local wrapper); never toast.error. The demo_compositions below are uilib-based wrappers; reuse them, do not fork shadcn equivalents.

forecast_chart.rule: Quantile-only: ForecastQuantileChart + normalizeForecastArtifact. Journey timeline: ForecastChart fed ONLY by mapJobToForecastChartData.
